_about: D11 military branches and battlefield strategy for Ardan (design notes only, nothing is built). Game-like: what beats what, terrain, timing. Fits src/war/engine/war.js (TACTICS hold/advance/charge/flank/volley/feint/withdraw, TERRAIN open/hills/forest/ford/pass, phases Skirmish/Clash/Press/Decision, ranks soldier/sergeant/captain/commander), 60-drill (tactics need a drill), 9997-companies (company 200, battalion 800), and the elite orders in orders.js. Odds shown to the player as words, never percentages. strongVs/weakVs are plain ids or phrases, not a rules table.

branches.name: Knights
branches.role: The noble heart of the army: a few hundred rich, armoured men who win battles at one moment or lose them.

ranks.title: Sergeant
ranks.leads: a lance of 8 knights and their squires

ranks.title: Commander
ranks.leads: the whole knightly host of a realm

branches.training: Wedge and charge drill; riding and lance skill; squire years first.
branches.gear: Plate or mail, warhorse, lance, sword, shield.
branches.careerPath: Page, squire, knight, banner captain, marshal.

branches.name: Heavy lancers
branches.role: Shock cavalry: one great blow on a prepared foe, then they are spent.
branches.training: Wedge and charge drill; couched lance.
branches.gear: Barded horse, long lance, heavy armour.
branches.careerPath: Squire, lancer, lance leader, squadron captain, marshal of horse.

branches.name: Mounted men-at-arms
branches.role: The all-round armoured horseman: charges, but also fights on after the lance breaks.
branches.training: Charge drill plus weapons drill; sword and mace.
branches.careerPath: Sergeant-at-arms, rider, lance leader, company captain, cavalry commander.

branches.name: Dismounted knights
branches.role: Knights who leave the horse to hold a line: strong, slow, and hard to break, with no escape.

ranks.title: Soldier
ranks.leads: a knight in the shield line

branches.training: Shield-wall and weapons drill; stand and do not run.
branches.gear: Full plate, axe, sword, large shield; horses held behind.
branches.careerPath: Knight, banner captain on foot, marshal of the line.

branches.name: Light cavalry
branches.role: Eyes and teeth of the army: scouting, harrying, chasing, cutting off supply.

ranks.title: Commander
ranks.leads: all light horse of the host

branches.training: Skirmish and feigned-flight drill; riding and bow.
branches.gear: Horse, javelin or bow, light mail or none.
branches.careerPath: Rider, troop sergeant, company captain, master of scouts.

branches.name: Scout Regiment
branches.role: Few, hidden, deadly to a plan: they see first, strike a man in the night, and decide where the battle is fought.

ranks.title: Soldier
ranks.leads: a scout alone or a pair

branches.training: Stealth, tracking, bow and knife; oath of silence; trials fail most.
branches.gear: Dark cloak, short bow, knife, climbing gear, poison.
branches.careerPath: Runner, scout, patrol leader, company captain, master of scouts (court rank).

branches.name: Spear and pike infantry
branches.role: The wall that horses will not charge: cheap, solid, and the best answer to cavalry.

ranks.title: Commander
ranks.leads: a battalion or division of foot

branches.training: Shield-wall drill; hold step and do not break.
branches.gear: Long spear or pike, shield, helm.
branches.careerPath: Levy, spearman, file leader, company captain, battalion commander.

branches.name: Men-at-arms on foot
branches.role: Professional foot who win the grind: armoured, trained, hard hitting.
branches.training: Weapons and formation drill; shield and axe.
branches.careerPath: Soldier, sergeant, captain, senior captain, commander of foot.

branches.name: Archers
branches.role: Many arrows from afar: wear the foe down, tire his horses, and open the line.
branches.training: Weapons drill; volley and draw; much practice.
branches.gear: Bow, arrow sheaf, stakes, light armour.
branches.careerPath: Bowman, file leader, company captain, master of archers.

branches.name: Crossbowmen
branches.role: Slower than bows but a bolt goes through plate: the knight-killer of any man who trains for a month.
branches.training: Weapons drill; cranking and volley; a short course.
branches.gear: Crossbow, bolts, pavise shield, mail shirt.
branches.careerPath: Crossbowman, squad leader, company captain, master of crossbows.

branches.name: Siege engineers
branches.role: Takes walls, builds fieldworks, bridges and camps, and keeps the army moving and fed.
branches.training: Siege and field works drill; craft skills and numbers.
branches.gear: Picks, ram, ladders, catapults, hide shields.
branches.careerPath: Hand, gang leader, engineer captain, master engineer.

branches.name: Garrisons
branches.role: Men who hold a place: they are slow to move and hard to dig out.

ranks.title: Captain
ranks.leads: a captain of the castle (100 to 200)

ranks.title: Commander
ranks.leads: castellan or marshal of the marches

branches.training: Weapons and shield drill; know the place; keep watch.
branches.gear: Mail, spear, crossbow or bow, shield.
branches.careerPath: Guard, watch sergeant, castle captain, castellan.

branches.name: Levies
branches.role: The mass: cheap, many, and brittle; they break first and cost the least.

ranks.title: Soldier
ranks.leads: a farmer called to the host

ranks.title: Captain
ranks.leads: a hundred of a hundred-man levy

branches.training: None, or a week at the muster.
branches.gear: Spear, club, sling, whatever they own.
branches.careerPath: Called up, headman, levy captain; some are made soldiers.

branches.name: Mercenary companies
branches.role: Hired professionals: reliable while paid, risky when not.
branches.training: Whatever the company trains; hard-learned in many wars.
branches.gear: Mixed; best that coin can buy.
branches.careerPath: Sellsword, corporal, company captain, captain-general; fortune or ruin.

branches.name: Elite orders
branches.role: A few hundred sworn men who count as thousands: their arrival sways morale and the day.
branches.training: Three trials; oath; a lifetime of drill.
branches.gear: The best gear in the realm; a mark of the order.
branches.careerPath: Aspirant, sworn brother, blade, captain, marshal, grand master.

tactics.name: Couched lance charge
tactics.needs: open ground; wedge drill; a foe not behind stakes
tactics.risk: Stakes or a pike wall; the lancers are spent after one blow.

tactics.name: Spear wall
tactics.needs: shield-wall drill; hills, ford or pass; a steady captain
tactics.risk: Archers and a flank attack; stuck in place.

tactics.name: Archers behind stakes
tactics.needs: stake line; high or broken ground; time to set
tactics.risk: Light cavalry round the back; a fast foe in the open.

tactics.name: Feigned retreat
tactics.needs: feint drill; steady men; a hasty or bold foe
tactics.risk: If the men truly run it is a rout.

tactics.name: Flank swing
tactics.beats: a foe who holds the centre
tactics.risk: The flank may be seen, or the centre may break.

tactics.name: Dismount and hold
tactics.needs: good ground; no escape; strong captain
tactics.beats: cavalry, a foe who hits hard

tactics.name: Crossbow volley at the armoured
tactics.risk: Closing too fast; rain; light horse.

tactics.name: Scout screen and ambush
tactics.needs: forest or hills; a march in column
tactics.beats: a column on the march; supply trains
tactics.risk: The foe has scouts too; a big army can fight back.

tactics.name: Night knife
tactics.needs: a way in; a target; patience
tactics.beats: an enemy captain or general; the stores
tactics.risk: If caught the Regiment is lost and the realm is shamed.

tactics.name: Siege works and sally
tactics.needs: time, stores, a gate or mine
tactics.beats: a walled foe; or a besieger by a sally

tactics.name: Hold the reserve for the decision
tactics.needs: a reserve unit; a read of the field
tactics.beats: a wavering line at the Decision phase
tactics.risk: Spending it too early or too late.

tactics.name: Pursuit of the broken
tactics.beats: a foe in rout (the kill count)

terrainEffects.open: Cavalry's best ground; archers see far but are charged; the wide front favours the side with more men.
terrainEffects.hills: The defender gets high ground; archers shoot further; cavalry is slowed (uphill).
terrainEffects.forest: Cavalry is crippled and archers are blinded; infantry and scouts rule; the front is narrow.
terrainEffects.ford: The defender is hard to dislodge; cavalry splashes in; archers and crossbows kill those wading.
terrainEffects.pass: A narrow front: numbers count for little; the defender holds with a few; the elite orders shine; cavalry is almost useless.
terrainEffects.marsh: Heavy men bog down; light foot and scouts live; no cavalry charge.
terrainEffects.siege: Engineers and crossbows count; cavalry sits idle; hunger and time decide.
terrainEffects.night: Scouts and knives rule; large armies are blind; an ambush is deadly.
